title_options: Zep Temporal Memory and Stale Facts: A Reproducible 30-Case Fixture (2026)
Why Your Agent Returns Old Facts: A 30-Case Zep-Style Temporal Memory Fixture
Temporal Invalidation Policies, Tested: A 30-Case Stale-Fact Fixture You Can Re-run
presentation.title_rationale: Front-loads the topic readers search for (Zep temporal memory), then the reader problem (stale facts), then the one supported benefit: a 30-case fixture you can run and verify yourself. The previous title used "Tested", which read as testing Zep or Graphiti; neither product is executed, so that word was removed rather than qualified.
presentation.visual_purpose: Shows the article's central comparison in one frame: four modelled policies against two query instants, with the stale-return rate and exact accuracy taken from the clean-extraction cells of results/stale_fact_matrix.csv. It makes visible why invalidation alone fixes current-truth queries but not as-of queries, and it labels itself as fixture output so no reader mistakes it for a vendor benchmark.
